intro: Eagan Peltskinner asks you to hunt wolves prowling Northshire Valley and bring him their meat. He waits outside Northshire Abbey, where the valley’s needs continue despite the guards’ focus on Defias bandits.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I hate those nasty timber wolves! But I sure like eating wolf steaks... Bring me tough wolf meat and I will exchange it for something you'll find useful.
Tough wolf meat is gathered from hunting the timber wolves and young wolves wandering the Northshire countryside.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hey friend. I'm getting hungry...did you get that tough wolf meat?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've been busy! I can't wait to cook up that wolf meat...
I have some things here you might want - take your pick!

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
